title: Component Contracts - Improve Form Inputs
description: Prop interfaces and contracts for DateInput and TimeInput components

DateInput.description: Date input field with HTML5 calendar picker. Displays a single input with native browser date picker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the input element. Used for accessibility (label htmlFor, aria-describedby).

label.description: Label text displayed above the input field.

value.description: Current date value in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty string if no date selected.

onChange.description: Callback invoked when date changes. Receives ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) as argument.

onBlur.description: Callback invoked when input loses focus. No arguments.

error.description: Error message to display below the input. If provided, input shows error state with aria-invalid.
error.example: Date cannot be in the future

required.description: Whether the field is required. Shows asterisk in label and sets HTML required attribute.

max.description: Maximum selectable date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Dates after this are disabled in picker.

emits.description: Emitted when user selects a date from the calendar picker or types a valid date.
Emitted when the input field loses focus.

accessibility.ariaLabel: Provided by htmlFor association with Label component
accessibility.ariaInvalid: Set to true when error prop is provided
accessibility.ariaDescribedBy: Set to {id}-error when error message is displayed
accessibility.ariaRequired: Set when required prop is true
keyboardNav: Arrow keys: Navigate dates in picker

testingNotes.userEvent: Use userEvent.type() or userEvent.click() to open picker
testingNotes.integration: Verify onChange receives ISO format string

TimeInput.description: Time input field with HTML5 time picker. Displays a single input with native browser time picker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the input element. Used for accessibility (label htmlFor, aria-describedby).

label.description: Label text displayed above the input field.

value.description: Current time value in 24-hour HH:mm format. Empty string if no time selected.

onChange.description: Callback invoked when time changes. Receives time string in 24-hour HH:mm format.

onBlur.description: Callback invoked when input loses focus. No arguments.

error.description: Error message to display below the input. If provided, input shows error state with aria-invalid.
error.example: Last meal time must be after first meal time

required.description: Whether the field is required. Shows asterisk in label and sets HTML required attribute.

format.description: ADVISORY ONLY. Indicates user's preferred time format. Browser may display time based on OS locale instead. Value is always returned in 24-hour HH:mm format.
format.note: This prop does not control display in HTML5 time inputs. Browser uses OS locale settings.

emits.description: Emitted when user selects a time from the picker or types a valid time. Always in 24-hour format.
Emitted when the input field loses focus.

accessibility.ariaLabel: Provided by htmlFor association with Label component
accessibility.ariaInvalid: Set to true when error prop is provided
accessibility.ariaDescribedBy: Set to {id}-error when error message is displayed
accessibility.ariaRequired: Set when required prop is true
keyboardNav: Arrow keys: Increment/decrement time in picker

testingNotes.userEvent: Use userEvent.type() or userEvent.click() to open picker
testingNotes.formatNote: Do not test display format - browser controls this based on locale

backwardCompatibility.DateInput: 100% compatible - all prop names, types, and signatures unchanged
backwardCompatibility.TimeInput: 100% compatible - all prop names, types, and signatures unchanged. Note: 'format' prop is now advisory only.

DateInput: Calendar picker UI varies by browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari have different styles)
Default value can now be set to today's date via EntryForm (was empty before)
TimeInput: Time display format (12h/24h) follows OS locale settings, not 'format' prop
Value is always returned in 24-hour HH:mm format regardless of display

DateInput: Remove tests for day/month/year separate fields
Add tests for single date input with HTML5 type
Add tests for max date validation
Add tests for calendar picker accessibility
TimeInput: Add tests for single time input with HTML5 type
Remove tests for format conversion (browser handles this)
Add tests for time picker accessibility

DateInputCreateMode.description: Creating a new entry with today's date as default

DateInputEditMode.description: Editing an existing entry with pre-filled date

TimeInputFirstMeal.description: First meal time input in entry form

TimeInputLastMeal.description: Last meal time input with validation

EntryFormIntegration.description: Complete EntryForm with new date/time inputs
